title: AM v2: label ml_entry / ml_entry_eq decisions with cf_bar_labels.build_rows so the heads can be graded on ML entry sources
note: The run-w corpus (469,172 trades) holds rule-strategy backtest trades only; NO ml_entry / ml_entry_eq trades, so per-source cuts and any claim for ML entry is transfer-only (operator 2026-11-23: heads must be consumable by ANY entry source, pooled where the registered test supports it, per-source cuts reported; a pooled head acting on a real-money leg still needs its own population test). Build: take ml_decision_entry taken decisions (policy() output with entry/sl from the 2/3 ATR bracket) and ml_entry_eq decisions, call cf_bar_labels.build_rows per decision on the same bars, tag strategy=ml_entry/ml_entry_eq, append to the label corpus, report per-source cuts in am_heads_fit.py.
